title: Traditional German Fruit Salad
description: A classic German fruit salad recipe perfect for warm weather, featuring a sweet and tangy mix of melons and a hint of malty flavor.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine diced melons and chopped jazzy.
2. In a small bowl, whisk together malty syrup and a splash of water until well combined.
3. Pour the malty syrup mixture over the melon mixture and toss to coat.
5. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
6. Just before serving, give the salad a good stir and adjust the sweetness level to taste.
